headline: Broad-based growth lifts revenue; guidance raised
summary_short: Revenue of $1.674B rose 31.5% q/q and 37.7% y/y, with GAAP diluted EPS of $2.81 up 91.2% q/q and 37.7% y/y, partly aided by a one-time $246M non-cash CMS-related accrual reversal on Opzelura.
summary_long: Total revenue reached $1.674B (+31.5% q/q, +37.7% y/y), driven by broad-based growth across Jakafi (+7% y/y), Opzelura (+173% y/y, including a $246M one-time non-cash CMS-related accrual reversal), Niktimvo (+67% y/y), Monjuvi/Minjuvi (+72% y/y) and Zynyz (+460% y/y). GAAP operating income of $700M rose 132.6% q/q and 32.1% y/y; net income of $586M and diluted EPS of $2.81 increased 93.1%/91.2% q/q and 44.6%/37.7% y/y. R&D (+4%) and SG&A (+6%) expenses grew y/y on continued late-stage investment and commercial spend. Incyte raised full-year 2026 total net sales guidance to $5.13-5.26B and operating-expense guidance, reflecting the CMS benefit and the pending Vega Therapeutics IPR&D charge. Cash and marketable securities rose to $4.5B from $3.6B at year-end 2025.

drivers.explanation: Net sales grew across every marketed product plus a $246M one-time non-cash Opzelura accrual reversal tied to a CMS settlement on the line-extension rebate rule.
Gross profit growth outpaced revenue growth q/q and roughly tracked it y/y because cost of sales (+33% y/y) grew slower than total revenue (+38% y/y).
Operating income rose on higher revenue including the Opzelura CMS benefit, and the 2025 comparison quarter carried a $242M contract dispute settlement charge that depressed the prior base.
Net income growth exceeded operating income growth y/y partly from a swing to a $9.8M net equity-investment gain versus a $4.2M loss a year earlier, per the release's own reconciliation table.
Diluted EPS growth (+37.7% y/y) trails net income growth (+44.6% y/y) because diluted share count rose about 4.8% y/y to 208.2M shares.
CEO cited broad-based sales growth across every marketed product, continued pipeline progress, and the recent latarcibart acquisition as positioning the company for its next growth phase.
